entries.title: Psalms 6:1
segments: ¶<To the chief music-maker on corded instruments, on the Sheminith. A Psalm. Of David.> O Lord, do not be bitter with me in your wrath; do not send punishment on me in the heat of your passion.

entries.title: Psalms 6:2
segments: Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I am wasted away: make me well, for even my bones are troubled.

entries.title: Psalms 6:3
segments: My soul is in bitter trouble; and you, O Lord, how long?

entries.title: Psalms 6:4
segments: Come back, O Lord, make my soul free; O give me salvation because of your mercy.

entries.title: Psalms 6:5
segments: For in death there is no memory of you; in the underworld who will give you praise?

entries.title: Psalms 6:6
segments: The voice of my sorrow is a weariness to me; all the night I make my bed wet with weeping; it is watered by the drops flowing from my eyes.

entries.title: Psalms 6:7
segments: My eyes are wasting away with trouble; they are becoming old because of all those who are against me.

entries.title: Psalms 6:8
segments: ¶Go from me, all you workers of evil; for the Lord has given ear to the voice of my weeping.

entries.title: Psalms 6:9
segments: The Lord has given ear to my request; the Lord has let my prayer come before him.

entries.title: Psalms 6:10
segments: Let all those who are against me be shamed and deeply troubled; let them be turned back and suddenly put to shame.
